idea.target_audience: B2B companies (10-100 employees) struggling to maintain consistent social media presence and showcase their company culture, particularly SaaS startups, consulting firms, and service-based businesses
idea.monetization_model: Freemium SaaS: Free tier (5 stories/month), Starter ($29/month, 25 stories + basic templates), Growth ($79/month, unlimited stories + advanced editing + analytics), Enterprise ($199/month, multi-brand + custom templates + API access). Additional revenue from premium content templates ($9.99 each) and done-for-you content packages ($299/month).
mvp_features: Slack/Teams integration: Automatically scans workplace communications for story-worthy moments using AI sentiment analysis
AI Story Generator: Transforms raw internal updates into polished LinkedIn posts, tweets, and newsletter content with brand voice consistency
Content Calendar Dashboard: Schedule and manage all generated content across multiple social platforms with approval workflows
Team Story Suggestions: Gamified feature where team members can submit story ideas and vote on favorites, creating viral internal engagement
Analytics & Story Bank: Track content performance and build a searchable library of company stories for future repurposing
